text: dsh-statusbar 是面向 DSH Web 的底部状态栏插件，在 shell.overlay 显示会话和主机信息，并在设置页管理显示条目。它汇总当前会话的估算 token、轮数与步骤、模型和工具耗时、首 token 延迟、生成速率及缓存用量，也展示主机 CPU、内存和时钟。用户可以调整条目的可见性、左右位置与顺序；其他宿主插件还能注册文本、进度条或异步数据源。适合希望在网页界面快速查看会话性能与主机状态的 DSH 用户，以及需要共享状态栏扩展接口的插件作者。需要安装在 DSH web profile 中；代码未要求额外密钥或外部账号。

dsh-statusbar adds a bottom bar to DSH Web for session and host status. It shows tokens, session timing, generation speed, cache usage, CPU, memory, and clock. Users can reorder or hide items. Host plugins can add text, progress bars, and data sources. Requires a DSH web profile; no extra keys.
想在 DSH 网页底部看到当前会话的 token 和生成速度。
有没有办法同时查看 DSH 会话耗时和电脑 CPU、内存？
让 DSH Web 显示对话轮数、步骤数和模型调用时间。
我想把网页里状态信息的位置和顺序按自己习惯调整。
能不能把我自己插件提供的实时指标也放到 DSH 状态栏？
想在页面上看提示词缓存命中情况和输入输出 token 数。
Show my current DSH conversation's token count and generation speed in the browser.
Can I see host CPU and memory usage alongside my session stats?
dsh-statusbar 的功能「会话用量展示」：在网页状态栏列出当前会话的估算 token、轮数步骤、累计调用耗时、首 token 与生成速率、缓存命中及输入输出 token。客户端定时获取快照。
dsh-statusbar 的功能「主机资源监测」：在底部栏展示宿主机 CPU 与内存占用，并用渐变字符条表示百分比。CPU 和内存由宿主端读取系统指标后更新。
dsh-statusbar 的功能「条目个性化」：在设置页逐项开关显示、选择左右位置并修改排序，也可恢复默认。变更通过配置接口保存到 profile 旁的 JSON 文件。
dsh-statusbar 的功能「扩展数据源」：宿主插件可注册异步 provide 回调，返回文本、进度、颜色或提示；状态栏按刷新间隔更新，并在新值未返回时保留上次值。
dsh-statusbar 使用前须知：配置会写入 profile 目录下的 dsh-statusbar-config.json；路径取自宿主的 file: baseUrl。（见 lib/index.js:32-53）
dsh-statusbar 使用前须知：底部布局预留空间依赖 Web 应用当前的哈希类名；源码针对特定选择器设置 padding，构建样式变化时可能需要同步调整。（见 lib/client.js:9-18）

dsh-statusbar README · dsh-statusbar：A VSCode-style bottom status bar for **DeepSeek Harness Web**. Shows your conversation
usage, host CPU/memory, and a live generation rate — every item configurable.

[](https://github.com/Small-Miao/dsh-statusbar/releases) [](./CHANGELOG.md)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh.md)

dsh-statusbar README · Features：- 24px bottom bar rendered via the `shell.overlay` seat; the app frame reserves bottom
  space so the page content (sidebar settings, composer) is **never covered**.
- Built-in items (each individually configurable — see [Configuration](#configuration)):
  - `DSH` brand (left)
  - `⧉ Tokens` — estimated tokens of the current conversation (`tokenMeter`)
  - `7 轮 · 64 步` — session turns / steps (`sessionStats`)
  - `LLM 14m12s · 工具调用 48.4s` — accumulated LLM / tool wall time
  - `首 token 平均 1.3s · 129 tok/s` — first-token average + decode throughput
  - `缓存命中 97%` — prompt-side cache hit rate (`tokenUsage`)
  - `输入 7.4M tok · 输出 98.9K tok` — billed input / output tokens
  - `TPS 363 tok/s` — live generation rate (`liveTokenUsage`; needs [dsh-live-stats])
  - `CPU 20% [||||||||||]` — Linux-style colored char bar (green → yellow → red)
  - `MEM 55% (8.2G/14.8G) [||||||||||]` — memory usage with char bar
  - Host clock
- Hides the original stats line + TPS row under the composer input box (now redundant).
- Polls `/dsh-statusbar/snapshot?session=<id>` every 2 s.
dsh-statusbar README · Features：[dsh-live-stats]: https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui

dsh-statusbar README · Installation：Prerequisites: a DSH install with a web profile (e.g. the default `web` profile created by
`dsh web`).

```bash
dsh-statusbar README · from the GitHub repository：dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Small-Miao/dsh-statusbar
dsh-statusbar README · or via SSH (needs GitHub SSH access on this machine)：dsh plugin --profile web add git@github.com:Small-Miao/dsh-statusbar.git
section: or via SSH (needs GitHub SSH access on this machine)

text:
dsh-statusbar README · or from a local checkout (development)：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-statusbar
```

The command runs `pnpm add` in the profile, installs the bundle into
`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules`, and appends the plugin to `dsh.profile.bundles`.
Then **restart DSH**; the plugin mounts at startup and the bar appears after a page
refresh.

> Manual install (no `dsh plugin`): `pnpm --dir ~/.dsh/profiles/web add <path-or-url>`
> works too — the plugin is a standard `dsh.bundle` package.

dsh-statusbar README · Configuration：**Settings → 状态栏**: toggle each item's visibility, side (left / right), and order
(number input, ascending = further left), plus a "全部重置" (reset all) button.

Config is stored host-side and persisted to `dsh-statusbar-config.json` next to the
profile composition. HTTP: `GET /dsh-statusbar/snapshot?session=<id>` returns
`{ items, catalog, config }`; `POST /dsh-statusbar/config` accepts `{ id, patch }`
(`patch` = `{ visible?, align?, order? }`, or `null` to clear) or `{ resetAll: true }`.

dsh-statusbar README · Registering a data source：Data sources appear in the bar and in Settings → 状态栏 exactly like built-in items
(users can toggle/position them), and the host renders the last known value while a
slow `provide()` is in flight.

dsh-statusbar README · Development：```bash
git clone https://github.com/Small-Miao/dsh-statusbar
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-statusbar   # or symlink into the profile
```

- `lib/index.js` — host half: `statusbar` service, `/dsh-statusbar/*` HTTP routes,
  `node:os` CPU/memory sampling, session projections (`sessionStats` / `tokenUsage` /
  `liveTokenUsage`) cached 4 s per session.
- `lib/client.js` — browser half (`__ModuleLoader__` bundle): the bar in `shell.overlay`
  and the settings section in `settings.section`.

dsh-statusbar README · Layout note：The reserved bottom space relies on the app frame's hashed class (`.pI_x6G_frame` in the
current web build). If the web app is rebuilt with new CSS hashes, update that selector in
`lib/client.js`.
